story.vex: Your relay still answers to the name the factory gave it. Old habits sink ships. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The scouts' next knock finds a locked door. Astro: "One weak door found and welded shut. Volt, what else are we still shipping with the factory settings?"

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Volt's sensors caught someone knocking on the relay console. Read relay-notes.txt, then run Volt's Drill: try the door yourself before Doom does.

1. type relay-notes.txt
2. login relay admin        (Volt's Drill: prove the hole is real)
3. net user relay <a strong password>   (Rivet: patch it)
4. login relay admin        (prove the old key no longer works)
files.C:\\Citadel\\relay-notes.txt:
RELAY CONSOLE — maintenance card (Rivet)
-----------------------------------------
Installed: three tours ago, in a hurry, before the last supply run.
Account: relay
Password: never changed since the factory image. Still the default.

A vulnerability is a weakness a threat can use. A factory password left in place
is one of the oldest ones in the book — Doom's scouts try it on every door they find.

steps.title: Volt's Drill: prove the hole is real
steps.body: Volt: "Astro authorized this: we attack our own door first, so Doom can't." Read `relay-notes.txt` for the account name and its known password, then try it yourself: `login relay admin`. If it works, you've proven the vulnerability — write it down, don't celebrate yet.

objectives.label: Logged in as relay with the factory password

steps.title: Rivet's Workbench: patch it
steps.body: Rivet: "Found is fixed, Cadet. Give `relay` a real password." Run `net user relay <new-password>`, using at least 12 characters, a mix of upper and lower case, a number and a symbol, and nothing that spells out the account name or a common word.

objectives.label: relay's password was changed to a strong one

steps.title: Astro Says: prove the wall holds
steps.body: Astro: "Run it again. If the old key still turns, we've fixed nothing." Try `login relay admin` one more time. It should fail now.

objectives.label: The old factory password no longer works
